info.name: Tequipy Offboardings Sandbox
info.description: Run discovery separately, fill variables, then run folders 2–6 once in order. Creates four offboardings: two COMPLETED and two CANCELLED. Devices 1 and 2 become ACTIVE in company storage at a Tequipy warehouse on COMPLETE; devices 3 and 4 remain with their original employees. No redeployment is created by this collection.
